question: Which option shows the correct answer when 27°C is converted to the kelvin scale?
solution:
The correct answer is __300 K__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The formula to convert Celsius to Kelvin is K = °C + 273.15.
 
• When 27°C is converted to Kelvin, 27 + 273.15 = 300.15 K.
 
• For simplicity, it is usually rounded to 300 K.
 
• Kelvin is the SI unit of temperature and is used widely in scientific calculations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Temperature Conversion:**

 
 
• To convert from Celsius to Kelvin, simply add 273.15.
 
• To convert from Kelvin to Celsius, subtract 273.15.
 
 
 
• **Kelvin Scale:**
 
 
• The Kelvin scale starts at absolute zero, which is 0 K or -273.15°C.
 
• It is primarily used in scientific research to measure thermodynamic temperature.
 
 
 
• **Practical Usage:**
 
 
• Kelvin is commonly used in physics, chemistry, and engineering applications.
 
• It helps in avoiding negative values when dealing with temperature calculations.
